description: Actual grasp TCP pose relative to each OmniPicker base link
convention: T_parent_tcp = translation_m followed by fixed-axis roll-pitch-yaw; values are expressed in the named OmniPicker base-link frame
calibration_note: Measure from the OmniPicker base-link origin to the real grasp center. Positive/negative directions follow that local link frame, not MuJoCo world axes. Restart graspV2 after editing.
